title: Polynomial-time closure under a block-loop step
statement: Let $g$ be a function on finite bit strings, and let $\mathrm{step}(\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt})$ be the block-loop transformation defined by the paired-string encoding. If $g=\mathrm{step}(\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt})$, and both functions $s\mapsto \mathrm{upd}(\pi_1(s),\pi_2(\pi_2(s)))$ and $s\mapsto \mathrm{nxt}(\pi_1(s),\pi_2(\pi_2(s)))$ are computable in polynomial time, then $g$ is computable in polynomial time.
